node: Advanced AI accelerator packaging plus high-bandwidth memory
summary: Layer 1B universe expansion for the AI advanced-packaging/HBM node. The candidate set prioritizes US-listed or US-traded public companies with plausible direct or second-order exposure to AI accelerator packaging capacity, HBM supply, OSAT services, and inspection/metrology bottlenecks. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell list. Key bottleneck logic: AI accelerators increasingly require tightly integrated GPU/ASIC dies, interposers, substrates, and HBM stacks, so scarce capacity may accrue to memory suppliers, foundry advanced-packaging platforms, OSAT partners, and packaging inspection/metrology vendors.
